regions.why: "Main and main's Mac red, between passes: a revert on record, never said; main: a fix brief with no row; an old main fix brief with no row; main's Mac: a fix brief with no row" is "Wrong today", and its two region states would show "Works today"

classes.end: Main red, then green again, between passes: a revert open on GitHub, not on record
classes.rule: "An open revert on GitHub has its reverts.json record by the next pass": a revert GitHub had open when a pass started is kept once that pass has run to its end. jmerge merges, and reverts.close closes, only a revert reverts.json keeps, so one it does not keep stays open.
classes.cause: main turned green before a pass recorded the revert, so none judges it again

classes.end: Main's Mac red, between passes: a revert open on GitHub, not on record; main's Mac: a fix brief with no row
classes.rule: "After any crash a red tip has a fix row and its brief, or neither, by the next pass": main's red tip and its Mac's each, and each red run of a nightly, also one that aged past NIGHTLY_WINDOW. A brief with no row is a fix no crew is launched for. A pass that runs to its end queues each brief it writes, so this holds at the end of every such pass, the next one after a crash among them.
classes.cause: the pass died after the fix brief, and the next pass reverted in place of filing

classes.end: Main red, between passes: a revert open on GitHub, not on record; main: its fix row queued
classes.rule: "An open revert on GitHub has its reverts.json record by the next pass": a revert GitHub had open when a pass started is kept once that pass has run to its end. jmerge merges, and reverts.close closes, only a revert reverts.json keeps, so one it does not keep stays open.
classes.cause: GitHub did not answer, and the pass filed a row in place of recording the revert

classes.end: Main's Mac red, between passes: a revert on record, never said; main's Mac: no fix brief
classes.rule: jbus says each revert it opened: a revert reverts.json keeps has its line in events.jsonl.
classes.cause: the pass died after it recorded the revert, and no later pass says it
